reuse.why: Patches each of the five copied category queries and the copyPreviousMonth JS check individually instead of introducing one shared selection that takes the flag.

duplication.why: The identical `(? OR (c.hidden = 0 AND g.hidden = 0))` edit, parameter binding and signature change are repeated six times, deepening the existing query duplication.

placement.why: Edits stay in server/budget/actions.ts with the actions, but the category-selection rule remains spread across every action instead of one function.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions and their test change.

maintainability.why: Any further change to which categories are filled must again be made in five SQL strings and one JS filter, with drift risk between them.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared category-selection abstraction exists in this tree to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The five category queries in setZero, setLastMonthSpending and set3/6/12MonthAvg are openly identical copies with the same edit.
